title: Supporter links now go where they should
summary:
A little homepage tending: supporter links point outward, and a community slide generator joins the project list.

Homepage supporter URLs without a protocol now open as HTTPS links rather than resolving within pollinations.ai. The change also updated the black logo icon and added three color variants.

Kushai’s AI PowerPoint Generator was added to the community project list, giving visitors a way to find a tool that turns text into slides.
